foundry_calls.text: Wants? Wants you GONE. This goblin turf! But... shiny things change minds, maybe.
foundry_calls.speaker: Goblin

foundry_calls.text: It holds its ground, blade low, eyes flicking between your sword hand and your coin purse.
foundry_calls.speaker: Sage

llm_calls: [Aria]: Keeping my hand near my sword, I ask the goblin what it wants.
